verses.1: Which was the word of Jehovah to Jeremiah regarding the words of the prophets.
verses.2: But Judah’s gates were desolate and fallen. Jerusalem’s walls stood in ruins.
verses.3: And their captors sent their young men into the sea. They went there on their backs. They couldn’t find any water to drink. They all got drenched and became wet. Their heads were also covered with water.
verses.4: Along the land, it was said that there was no rain on the earth, so that the crops could not grow properly.
verses.5: For even Ayleth, who was born in the field, also left, because there was no one to take care of her.
verses.6: And they stood on their heads, sucking the air from their eyes. Their eyes were closed, for there was no light.
verses.7: If our enemies answer us, then we, the children of Jehovah, should do what is right for your sake. For our sins have multiplied over time, and we have sinned against you.
verses.8: From the tribe of Israel, who will be saved in times of trouble. Why should they become like strangers in this land, and like fugitives who wander around?
verses.9: Why should we be treated like a man who is paralyzed, unable to heal others? And you, who are among us, O LORD, your name is invoked upon us. Do not abandon us.
verses.10: As Jehovah said to this people, so they loved us. They did not turn away from us. Now, Jehovah will remember their sins and punish them for their wrongdoings.
verses.11: And the LORD said to him, “Do not plead for this people for their sake.”
verses.12: For they have gone away; I do not hear their cries. And when they come up from the ground, I do not want to eat or drink. In times of famine and hunger, I am able to provide for them.
verses.13: And he said, “Ah, Adonai Yehovah! Look, those who are flying over them say to them, ‘Do not fear destruction or hunger.’ There will be no such things as destruction or hunger for you. For I will give you peace in this place.”
verses.14: And the LORD said to me, “It is false prophets who are sent out in my name. They are not sent by me, nor commanded by me. I have never spoken to them in any way. They are false witnesses, charlatans, and deceivers. These people are sent out to deceive you.”
verses.15: Therefore, as the Lord has said, “Let those who are sent upon my behalf do so.” But I will not send them. And they say, “There will be no famine or starvation in this land.” But in fact, those who are sent upon my behalf will perish in famine and starvation.
verses.16: And the people who are brought to them will be thrown into the streets of Jerusalem due to starvation and destruction. Their wives, children, and grandchildren will not be buried with them. I have poured out their woes upon them.
verses.17: And you said to them, “Let these words be heard. My eyes will be filled with tears throughout the night and day. Do not be afraid, for great destruction has been caused by the daughter of my people. Many calamities have befallen us.”
verses.18: If I go into the wilderness, and there’s nothing but desolation and destruction. If I come to a city, and there’s widespread famine. Even prophets and priests sell themselves to other lands, without knowing what’s happening around them.
verses.19: May the Lord heal Judah, if it is in Zion that your soul is in distress. We have no one to heal us; there is no hope for us. There is no good or healing at all. And now, behold!
verses.20: We know that Jehovah knows about our sins and the sufferings of our ancestors, because we have sinned against You.
verses.21: Do not be angry, so that your name may not be profaned. Do not forget your covenant with us. Do not break your promise to us.
verses.22: In the depths of the nations, there are spirits and demons. But if heaven itself gives them over to us, then you, O LORD our God, will surely be able to deal with them. You have done all these things.
